title: Week 23 Mastery Quiz

questions.question: Which definition best matches “fixed cost”?
options: Examination of how costs, benefits, risks, and opportunities differ across groups.
The process through which one condition is expected to produce another.
A proposed law, constitutional amendment, bond, or other question submitted directly to voters.
A cost that does not vary with current output in the relevant period.
questions.explanation: Fixed cost means a cost that does not vary with current output in the relevant period.

options: A market with many firms selling differentiated products and relatively easy entry.
A cost that changes with output.
An election used to select party nominees or narrow the field of candidates.
Formal approval of a constitution, treaty, or amendment.

A professional public workforce selected and managed through established personnel systems.
Legal authority to spend public money for a designated purpose.
